metadata.title: Linking numbers and special differential characters in arithmetic hyperbolic manifolds
metadata.abstract: We construct non-holomorphic Siegel modular forms whose coefficients encode linking numbers in arithmetic hyperbolic manifolds of simplest type. Our proofs rely on an improved understanding of the transgression forms appearing in Kudla--Millson theory, and along the way we establish some structural properties including in particular their expected current equations.
